positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Covered is supporting healthcare staffing coverage, starting with Texas Optometrists seeking fill-in doctors/relief work opportunities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
– Developed customer-facing and internal front end interfaces with React for controlling and
reading information about the company's robots.
– Wrote application-level code in Python that helped the robots know what to do and when.
– Conducted field tests during pilots, reporting and fixing bugs.
– Explored business and product development opportunities on a small team of executives
and senior engineers.

positions.title: Applications Engineer
positions.description:
– Contributed code throughout the stack of a cloud-based IoT platform for robots.
– Led custom web application creation efforts for prominent customers.
– Served as a technical liaison between customers and core development by suggesting feature and bugfix priorities and providing technical customer support.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
– Created automated test tools in Python for UAV system hardware and firmware.
– Implemented bug fixes in system firmware with guidance from senior engineers.

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
– Created tests within C++ driver for electronic speed control to validate motor performance.
– Tuned PID on UAV electronic speed controllers, evaluated comparable motor controllers,
and determined through testing which option best facilitated flight stability.
– Worked with Product team to tune product specifications for optimal user experience.

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
– Designed, created and executed testing procedures for a memory component using VHDL, Quartus, Aldec, and SignalTap.
– Characterized monopole transmit antenna performance in a near-field coupling device and evaluated performance effects from various coupler components, including: radar absorbing material, enclosure shapes, and monopole receive antennas.
